title: Nvidia Lost  Trillion in 9 Days: Real Warning or Just Panic? Jensen Huang Returns
description_html:
Nvidia has brought back CEO Jensen Huang and Wall Street jumped about 5 percent in a single morning. But was the AI crash a real warning or just a panic? We explain how Nvidia lost roughly $1 trillion in market value in about 9 days, what the board says it knows and does not know about the Huang story, what it means for Asia and India's record foreign inflows, and what to watch next. Unproven allegations are labelled as reported.

Listen on Spotify and watch on YouTube: Global Meridian with Bikesh Roy.
